title: Benchmarking Coding Agents for System-Level Performance Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29695v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are becoming an increasingly important paradigm for automating software engineering tasks. However, existing coding benchmarks primarily evaluate agents at the function or repository level, leaving their capabilities in more complex distributed software systems largely unexplored. In practice, many modern applications adopt microservice architectures, where end-to-end performance emerges from interactions among multiple independently running services, requiring agents to reason beyond local code changes. To study this capability, we introduce MicroPerf-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on end-to-end performance optimization in microservice systems. Constructing such a benchmark is challenging because reproducible system-level performance fixes are sparse and difficult to attribute. translated_title: 面向系统级性能优化的编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 编码智能体正日益成为自动化软件工程任务的重要范式。然而，现有的编码基准主要在函数或代码仓库层面对智能体进行评估，它们在更复杂的分布式软件系统中的能力在很大程度上尚未被探索。在实践中，许多现代应用程序采用微服务架构，其端到端性能产生于多个独立运行的服务之间的交互，这要求智能体能够超越局部代码变更进行推理。为了研究这一能力，我们提出了MicroPerf-Bench，一个用于评估编码智能体在微服务系统中进行端到端性能优化能力的基准。构建这样的基准具有挑战性，因为可复现的系统级性能修复非常稀少且难以归因。我们通过将基于实证的性能反模式注入到真实的开源系统中来解决这一挑战……
tldr: 本文提出了MicroPerf-Bench，首个用于评估编码智能体在微服务系统中进行端到端性能优化能力的基准，通过向真实开源系统注入基于实证的性能反模式来构建测试场景，填补了现有基准仅停留在函数或仓库层面的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MicroPerf-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating coding agents on end-to-end performance optimization in microservice systems, constructed by injecting empirically grounded performance anti-patterns into real-world open-source systems to fill the gap left by existing benchmarks that only assess function- or repository-level capabilities.
